additionalOperatorObservations: While this passes validation testing I am unsure if this is the correct direction for the application.  We are asking the Operator to name the phase list what is supposed to be worked on and many more questions better determined by the  architect.  Phase generation should be built off the Project plan.  Aftern Project Plan is generated Architect should have enough information to lay out Roadmap to product release, phases for each milestone, MVP, Alpha, Beta, Release.
